release_read.basis: Revenue $3.77bn vs ~$3.35-3.38bn consensus (+12%), EPS $13.91 vs $12.71 Nasdaq forecast (+9%), and backlog jumping to $17.81bn from $14.06bn in one quarter (+27% q/q, +90% y/y) is a beat on every line the thesis named; only drag is gross margin flat at 24.8% y/y (below the 25.6% nine-month rate). Sized just under the 11.5% implied move because the last two beats were sold and the call (11:00 ET) is still to come.

guidance.detail: No numeric guidance in the release (the company guides qualitatively on the call); CEO: 'well-positioned to grow organically' through year-end and into 2027. The 'fourth raise' the judges expected can only come on the 11:00 ET call.

call.detail: Call is Friday 2026-10-23 at 10:00 Central = 11:00 ET, inside the session and after the 10:00 ET exit. Any qualitative revenue-growth guide and margin explanation lands there.

public_reaction.summary: Only RTTNews headline found ('Q3 income advances, beats estimates'); no analyst actions or price-reaction stories for the Q3 2026 print surfaced in search by 09:18 ET. No retail-tone source checked for lack of time.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 1215.0 (-5.03%); last print 1202.98 at 09:11 is the pre-market low (-5.97%), after-hours closed at -5.92%, high 1270.01 (-0.73%). 40 prints, 7 in the last 30 min, not stale. The market is selling a print that beat on revenue, EPS and backlog; the price sits ~14 points below the frozen release read, against the position. Likely drivers: sequential gross-margin step-down and the AI-infrastructure tape selling good prints (both named in the judges' notes), with SPY -0.4% and IWM -0.6% pre-market.

thesis_check.note: Release confirms the thesis (revenue beat, backlog +27% q/q, beat over a conservative consensus); the reaction contradicts it, repeating the pattern of the last two beats being sold (-5.3%, -2.7%). The 'fourth raise' is not yet visible: it depends on the call.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market that has traded at -5 to -6% since the after-hours, so the open should hold most of the gap (low p_open_lags), though the last prints are drifting lower. A gap against an unambiguous beat on every headline line is the case where a fade back toward the close is most likely in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn sterk (omzet ruim 12% boven verwachting, orderboek in een kwartaal 27% hoger), maar het aandeel staat voorbeurs ongeveer 5% lager, dus de positie staat op verlies. Een daling tegen zo'n duidelijk goed resultaat herstelt vaak deels in het eerste halfuur; verkoop daarom om 10:00 en niet bij de opening. Om 10:00 eruit betekent ook dat we het gesprek met analisten om 11:00 niet meer meemaken, dat de daling ook kan verdiepen.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als het aandeel voor 09:30 verder wegzakt richting -8% of een analist de koers verlaagt of afwaardeert met een concreet margeprobleem, dan direct bij de opening verkopen.
